environment: New isolated Supabase PostgreSQL 17 container; two synthetic databases; no network or host ports
checks: Owners, enum/domain ownership, disabled/replica hook state, SECURITY DEFINER ownership and exact sequence state match
Table/sequence ACLs and default privileges match
Restored authorization allows owner, hides other rows and denies outsider/function access
Called and unused sequence counters resume correctly above JavaScript safe integer range
Source counters unchanged; SELECT-only reader cannot advance them
Read-only audit accepts SELECT-only role and refuses column-only UPDATE grants
Inherited PUBLIC execution of a privileged writer is refused by catalog audit without invoking it or changing source rows
